visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular male character wearing a black tank top and a black baseball cap worn backward sits at a reflective glass table against a plain white background. He holds a smartphone and speaks with animated facial expressions. (2) The scene cuts to a top-down view of a wooden plate holding a scoop of white rice and a piece of cooked chicken breast. A smartphone is held over the plate to take a photograph. (3) Graphics and text overlays appear on screen, showing numerical data and nutrition labels in a digital app interface. The host gives a thumbs-up gesture. (4) The host introduces a slice of pizza on a wooden plate; he uses the smartphone to scan the food. Floating text elements show calorie comparisons. (5) A sandwich wrapped in plastic is shown, followed by the host holding it near his phone. Digital UI elements simulate a voice-to-text recording interface. (6) A wrapped rice ball is presented; the host scans the nutritional facts label on the back of the plastic packaging using the phone's camera. (7) The host returns to the initial seated position, smiling and gesturing with a thumbs-up towards the camera. A logo for the app 'FitHub' appears as an overlay.

(4) The host's voice continues with high arousal, punctuated by 'whoosh' transition sounds between different food levels. (5) During the sandwich phase, the narration is mixed with a slight digital filter effect to simulate a voice-command recording. (6) Frequent UI 'pop' and 'click' sound effects are synchronized with the scanning of a nutrition label. (7) The narration rises in pitch for a positive summary, ending with a brief musical stinger as the brand name is mentioned.
